text:
marta: Quick sync — I put together an initial 'Staging + Entitlement' runbook for cloud marketplace listings (AWS/GCP/Azure). Goal: make the staging entitlements predictable, document step-by-step handoffs, and capture the legal Q&A we always scramble for during launch. Link: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/runbooks/staging-entitlement (private)
aj: Nice. Could you call out the trial SKU behavior per-cloud? that's where we see most surprises from PMs.
marta: Yes — there's a top-level section for trial bundles + SKU mapping. Quick excerpt attached below.
sam_legal: I can take point on the legal Q&A section. Do we already have the EULA/localization checklist in there or should I add it?
marta: Not yet — please add EULA + localization + minimum required contract clauses. Also list the common redlines we accept for publisher storefronts.
kai_eng: I'll own the staging validation tests and the manifest schema. Can we include a small sample manifest sample in the runbook? saves time for partners.
aj: Please include the billing/product slug mapping table too — finance wants a canonical source.
marta: Excerpt (paste):
```
{
  "provider": "aws|gcp|azure",
  "offer_id": "redwood-inference-standard",
  "trial_sku": "trial-1000-tokens",
  "pricing_tiers": ["free-tier", "payg", "reserved-1"]
}
```
marta: Current checklist items (short):
- AMI/image or container reference confirmed (aws/gcp/azure)  @kai_eng
- SKU/trial mapping approved by finance  @aj
- EULA + localization added  @sam_legal
- Staging entitlements smoke tests added  @kai_eng
- Marketplace visibility copy + logos  marketing (not in thread)
kai_eng: For AMI/container references — note that AWS requires the AMI ID in a specific region. My plan: create a small script to validate AMI IDs and publish to the runbook. snippet:
```
aws ec2 describe-images --image-ids $AMI_ID --region us-east-1
```
sam_legal: Heads up — Azure requires a different acceptance criteria for trial terms. I'll add a short FAQ and the fallback language we can accept for offers that use third-party billing.
aj: For GCP, trials are gated by project entitlement — add the project-level service account step. I'll drop the quick command.
aj: gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT --member=serviceAccount:publisher@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/owner
marta: Thanks. One more decision: do we include an explicit rollback play if marketplace listing fails certification? proposing a 24-hour rollback window and auto-disable of trial SKUs. thoughts?
sam_legal: 24h rollback window is fine. Legal would like an audit trail requirement — keep records of who toggled trial SKUs.
kai_eng: Implementing toggle with audit logs is straightforward — we can leverage existing feature-flagging service. I'll add the runbook step and the ops play.
deploy-bot: deployment started: publish-runbook/staging-entitlement v1.0 -> staging (initiated by marta)
marta: Perfect — I'll assign owners in the doc and ping marketing for assets. I'll also schedule a 30-min handover with agents (PM + Eng + Legal) tomorrow at 10:00 PT. If anyone can't make it, flag here.
aj: I can make 10:00 PT.
sam_legal: I'll be there.
kai_eng: Confirmed.
marta: Great — next actions: sam_legal add legal Q&A, kai_eng add AMI/container validation + smoke tests, aj update SKU mapping table and commands. I'll run the handover and then we push to publisher staging. :thumbsup:
